create_mvp_config: create an MvpConfig instance to initialize a HuggingFace MVP model configuration with default settings
create_mvp_config_custom: create an MvpConfig instance with custom encoder layers, decoder layers, and d_model dimensions
create_mvp_config_prompt: create an MvpConfig instance with use_prompt enabled, prompt_length of 200, and prompt_mid_dim of 512
create_mvp_config_from_dict: create an MvpConfig instance from a dictionary of configuration parameters
create_mvp_config_checkpoint: create an MvpConfig instance loaded from the RUCAIBox/mvp checkpoint configuration
